We need to list elements that can be definitively identified based on isotope distribution patterns visible in the mass spectrum. We need the mass spectrum data. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool to get spectrum. Then analyze isotopic patterns: look for characteristic isotopic peaks (e.g., Cl has 3:1 ratio M+2, Br 1:1, S has M+2 ~4% etc). We need to identify which elements are definitively present based on patterns. Use retrieve_isotope_distribution to get isotopic patterns for reference.
